boards.name: ESP32-2432S028R "Cheap Yellow Display" 2.8" (ILI9341, one USB port)
boards.title: Cheap Yellow Display 2.8"
boards.tagline: The popular 2.8-inch ESP32 touchscreen with a single USB port.

boards.name: 2.8" CYD, two USB ports (ST7789, inverted colours)
boards.notes: Same pinout as the CYD with the ST7789 panel and inversion preset. Not tested on hardware; if the colours look wrong, use the serial commands in the README.
boards.title: Cheap Yellow Display 2.8", two USB ports
boards.tagline: The same board with a USB-C port beside the micro-USB one.

boards.name: ESP32-3248S035 3.5" "big CYD" (ST7796, 480x320)
boards.notes: Pins are the common ones for these boards and have not been verified on hardware. Resistive touch only.
boards.title: Big Yellow Display 3.5"
boards.tagline: The larger 3.5-inch version with a wider 480 x 320 screen.

boards.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.8 (368x448, V2: CO5300 + CST820)
boards.notes: Only ever run in the esp32sim emulator, never on the real board.
boards.title: Waveshare AMOLED 1.8"
boards.tagline: A small, very sharp AMOLED screen on an ESP32-S3 board.

boards.name: ESP32 with a 0.96" SSD1306 OLED module (128x64, I2C on GPIO 21 and 22)
boards.title: ESP32 + 0.96" OLED module
boards.tagline: A tiny text-only display on any ESP32 board: callsign, airline, altitude, speed and distance.
boards.notes: Text only (no 3D model, no photo, no touch: the BOOT button shows the next plane). Not tested on hardware or in the emulator.

boards.name: ESP32 board with the 0.96" OLED built in (Wemos LOLIN32 / TTGO style, I2C on GPIO 5 and 4)
boards.title: ESP32 with a built-in 0.96" OLED
boards.tagline: The same text-only display on boards that have the OLED on the PCB (Wemos / TTGO style).
boards.notes: Pins are the common ones for these boards; boards differ (use 'set i2c <sda> <scl>' if the screen stays blank). Never tested.
